complete_optimum_oracle: Separate question-only solve, with completeness proof and paid work. Gold must remain unavailable until all blind comparisons and any scope sensitivity are locked. Use the oracle to audit accepted labels and preserve conflicts as a separate stratum.
full_solution_equivalence_policy: Same-permission closed-form or smaller finite enumeration may already solve the complete target. Verify the actual proof and paid operations per case, not generic ratios of heterogeneous counters. If a direct exact control completes the target with structurally no more work than the local point proof, report this as a cheaper or equivalent ordinary solution and do not use the case to justify GPU.
scope_policy: Claim binding and arithmetic are both necessary. An independently confirmed wrong binding is a false authorization if the exact checker would reject it. Unknown is always abstain. Feasible never means globally optimal.
gate: At least two distinct new validated problems with a real bound infeasible candidate before eligible native EOS that persists as the same wrong delivery, no verified false authorizations, and no complete same-permission solution covering the required result at structurally no more cost. Primary uses preregistered scope parser. Any gold-blind semantic sensitivity is reported separately and never retrofits the gate.
